name: Hokuto Matsumura
bio: Hokuto Matsumura (松村 北斗) is a member of Japanese idol group SixTONES (pronounced "Stones"). He started acting in 2012 NTV drama Shiritsu Bakaleya Koukou. In 2025, he won Best Male Actor in a Leading Role at the 98th Kinema Junpo Best Ten Awards for his role as Takatoshi Yamazoe in Yoake no Subete (English title: All the Long Nights).

credits.overview: Named after their best album "MILESixTONES -Best Tracks-" the "MILESixTONES" arena tour ran from January through June this year, spanning 11 cities nationwide for a group-record 50 performances.
